en: I'd give a Seedot for a Ralts. Would you trade one with me?
text: Aș da un Seedot pentru un Ralts. Ai face schimb cu mine?

en: A Ralts! Thank you. Dots is a bit of a sleepyhead, so be gentle.
text: Un Ralts! Mulțumesc. Dots e cam somnoros, așa că fii blând.

en: That isn't a Ralts. I'm only after a Ralts.
text: Ăsta nu e un Ralts. Eu vreau doar un Ralts.

en: All right. If you ever catch a Ralts, come and see me.
text: Bine. Dacă prinzi vreodată un Ralts, vino să mă vezi.

en: Ralts feels what I feel, and I love it. How is Dots?
text: Ralts simte ce simt eu și îmi place. Ce mai face Dots?
